name: aether-wcag-scanner
description: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility scanner with RAG-powered fix generation. Scans live URLs via Playwright + axe-core across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports and returns violations paired with corpus-backed fixes and WCAG technique references.

api_key.title: Allchemy Labs API key
api_key.description: Your Allchemy Labs beta key from https://beta.allchemylabs.ai/?src=install (sign in with GitHub). Enables corpus-grounded fixes from the hosted insights engine; the scanner itself runs locally. Change it later with /plugin configure aether-wcag-scanner@allchemylabs.

post_edit_hook.title: Post-edit accessibility check
post_edit_hook.description: After Claude edits an HTML/JSX/Vue/Svelte file, a quick heuristic check reports possible accessibility issues to Claude. Set to false to turn it off in every project. A project can override this with AETHER_POSTEDIT_HOOK=0 or 1 in the env block of its .claude/settings.local.json.
